type.name: Object
type.description: Universal base type for every entity represented in Lingvo.

identity.field: Stable unique identity of the object.

type-system.relation: Object is an instance or specialization of another type.
Object is an instance of a defined object type.
Object is a variant of another object or type.

structure.relation: Object is structurally contained by another object.
Object is composed from other objects.
Object belongs to a structural group.
structure.property: Position of an object within its containing structure.

constraints.relation: Object is constrained by another object, rule or condition.
constraints.property: Conditions under which the object is valid.

dimensions.relation: Object can be described through a dimension.
Object participates in a particular analytical dimension.

aspects.relation: Object possesses or can be examined through an aspect.
Object is described by an aspect.

functions.relation: Object has a function, capability or role.
Object serves a particular purpose or structural role.

relations.relation: Object repeats another object or pattern.
Object continues another object or process.
Object represents another object or concept.

systems.relation: Object is a member of a system.

context.property: Context in which the object exists or is interpreted.

transformation.relation: Object originated through transformation from another object.
Object transforms into another object or state.
Object realizes another structure, function or possibility.

scale.relation: Object exists at a larger structural scale.
Object exists at a smaller structural scale.

type.name: Container
type.description: Object capable of containing other objects.

type.name: Linguistic Object
type.description: Object participating in linguistic structure, expression, meaning or communication.

type.name: Signal Object
type.description: Object representing an acoustic, perceptual or signal-level entity.

type.name: Dimension
type.description: Analytical dimension through which objects can be described.

type.name: Aspect
type.description: Analytical characteristic through which an object can be examined.

type.name: Function
type.description: Function represents a capability, role, operation or purpose associated with an object.

type.name: Relation
type.description: Relation represents a typed connection between objects.

type.name: System
type.description: System organizes relationships and processes involving multiple objects.

type.name: State
type.description: State represents a condition of an object at a particular point or interval.

type.name: Transformation
type.description: Transformation represents a change from one state, structure or object configuration to another.

object-type.name: Clause / Sentence / Utterance
object-type.description: Existing Lingvo Clause / Sentence / Utterance object.

object-type.name: Syllable / Prosodic Unit
object-type.description: Existing Lingvo Syllable / Prosodic Unit object.

function.name: Grouping
function.description: Groups objects into a meaningful unit.

function.name: Ordering
function.description: Establishes or maintains order between objects.

function.name: Naming
function.description: Identifies or labels an entity, concept or object.

function.name: Reference
function.description: Establishes reference to an entity, concept or context.

function.name: Modification
function.description: Qualifies, restricts or modifies another object.

function.name: Predication
function.description: Attributes a state, property or event to an argument.

function.name: Question
function.description: Requests or structures information as a question.

function.name: Command
function.description: Expresses a directive or requested action.

function.name: Response
function.description: Responds to a preceding object, event or communicative act.

extension-point.accepts: type property aspect function relation dimension system

model.name: OntoLex-Lemon
model.description: Model for representing lexical information and lexical entries.

model.name: Universal Dependencies
model.description: Framework for morphological and syntactic annotation.

model.name: Morpho-Syntactic Annotation Framework
model.description: Framework for word-level morphological and morphosyntactic annotation.

model.name: Syntactic Annotation Framework
model.description: Framework for syntactic annotation and structure.
